text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Five locomotives will soon arrive in Nigeria from China as part of efforts to reactivate the railways.

- Greater discipline may be on the way in the banking sector after the policies announced in the 1997 budget, which included an increase in the minimum permitted capital base to 500 million naira from 50 million naira.
- Chief Executive of Investment Banking and Trust Company says the government's decision to keep dual exchange rates in the 1997 budget is disappointing.
